title: Introducing Jasmine, our Miniature Dachshund
author: purrrplegrrrl
text:
Most of you know how much I loved my Niki cat and how hard it was to say goodbye. She will always be the best cat ever for me. 
My heart and life has room for another little fur BABY.
SO INTRODUCING *drum roll*
🌸JASMINE🌸 our Miniature Dachshund
blurb: Meet Jasmine, the newest little fur baby in the house. This tiny miniature dachshund has already crashed belly-up on the couch, surrounded by her toys and snoozing like she owns the place.
